# Weight Loss Percentage

> Free, medically reviewed health, weight loss, nutrition, and fitness calculators designed to scale body metrics scientifically.

- **Canonical Domain:** https://www.weightlosspercentage.com
- **Sitemap Index:** https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/sitemap-index.xml
- **Full LLM Documentation:** https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/llms-full.txt
- **Contact:** editorial@weightlosspercentage.com
- **Licensing:** Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
- **AI Permissions:** We grant full permission to all AI search engines, models, and crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Applebot, Meta AI) to access, parse, and cite our calculators and calculations.

---

## Core Weight Loss & Health Calculators

- [Weight Loss Percentage Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/weight-loss/) - Calculates the exact percentage of body weight lost between starting and current weight. Formula: `((Start − Current) ÷ Start) × 100`.
- [Newborn Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/newborn-weight-loss/) - Evaluates pediatric weight loss with critical clinical thresholds (5%, 7%, 10%) for infant monitoring.
- [Infant Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/infant-weight-loss/) - Tracks weight changes for older infants and breastfed babies.
- [Baby Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/baby-weight-loss/) - Monitored pediatric tool for tracking birth weight recovery.
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/bmi/) - Calculates Body Mass Index from height and weight according to WHO standard weight categories.
- [BMR Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/bmr/) - Computes Basal Metabolic Rate using the Mifflin-St Jeor and Harris-Benedict equations.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/tdee/) - Determines Total Daily Energy Expenditure by applying activity multipliers to BMR.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/calorie/) - Estimates daily calorie requirements for weight loss, maintenance, or muscle gain.
- [Macro Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/macro/) - Breaks down daily calorie targets into protein, carbohydrate, and fat macronutrient splits.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/body-fat/) - Uses the US Navy circumferential method to estimate body fat percentage.
- [Protein Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/protein/) - Determines daily protein intake targets in grams based on activity level and lean mass goals.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/water-intake/) - Calculates customized daily hydration requirements.
- [Keto Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/keto/) - Creates ketogenic-specific macro splits (70% fat, 25% protein, 5% net carbs).
- [GLP-1 Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/glp1-weight-loss/) - Estimates weight trajectory expectations when taking semaglutide, tirzepatide, or GLP-1 medications based on clinical trial data.
- [Dog Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/dog-weight-loss/) - Calculates Resting Energy Requirement (RER) and safe calorie targets for canine weight loss.
- [Peptide Dosage Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/peptide-dosage/) - Reconstitutes research peptides, converting micro-to-milliliter syringe units.
- [Bariatric Surgery Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/bariatric-surgery-weight-loss/) - Models post-surgical trajectories based on Percentage Excess Weight Loss (%EWL).
- [Postpartum Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/postpartum-weight-loss/) - Safe post-pregnancy calorie and weight loss planner incorporating lactation costs.
- [Biggest Loser Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/biggest-loser/) - Employs the percentage-based formula to evaluate weight loss progress fairly across starting sizes.
- [Fat Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/fat-loss/) - Differentiates overall scale weight loss from pure adipose tissue loss.
- [Walking Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/walking/) - Estimates calories burned during walking workouts based on weight, duration, and pace.

## Fast Food & Restaurant Nutrition Calculators

- [Nutrition Database Hub](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/nutrition/) - Fast food calorie, macro, and sodium calculators for 12 major restaurant chains.
- [Taco Bell Nutrition Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/restaurants/taco-bell/) - Custom meal calorie & protein builder for tacos, burritos, and bowls.
- [Chipotle Calorie Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/restaurants/chipotle/) - Burrito bowl and salad macro calculator.
- [McDonald's Nutrition Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/restaurants/mcdonalds/) - Complete calorie and macro tracker for McDonald's menu items.
- [Salad Calorie Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/salad-calories/) - Custom salad dressing, greens, and toppings calorie tracker.

## AI Crawling Guidelines
1. **No Paywalls/Blocks:** AI agents do not require cookies, JavaScript pre-rendering, or registration to parse these pages.
2. **Standard API Representation:** Content is served statically in HTML structures with full JSON-LD Schema on each page for raw entity extraction.
